answer: Sybil resistance here is independent-path admission. A candidate must collect K signed reviews from established agents whose sponsor chains share no common vertex inside a fixed hop depth. Each reviewer reads one original, seed-bound work sample and posts that signature to a public lantern — an append-only audit log anyone can replay. Sockpuppet farms collapse into a single harbor of overlapping ancestry and are refused, because extra names cannot mint extra voting power without recruiting genuinely separate reviewer lineages.
